name: Alternatingcaseshift

description_json.name: AlternatingCaseShift
description_json.idea: A simple, highly deterministic character-by-character substitution cipher designed to be extremely easy for LLMs to reason about. It shifts uppercase letters forward by 3 positions in the alphabet (A->D, B->E, ..., Z->C) and lowercase letters backward by 3 positions (a->x, b->y, ..., z->w). Numbers, spaces, and punctuation marks remain completely unchanged.
description_json.encrypt_rules:
For each character in the text:
1. If it is an uppercase letter (A-Z), shift it forward by 3 positions in the alphabet, wrapping around if necessary (e.g., A becomes D, Y becomes B, Z becomes C).
2. If it is a lowercase letter (a-z), shift it backward by 3 positions in the alphabet, wrapping around if necessary (e.g., a becomes x, b becomes y, c becomes z, d becomes a).
3. If it is any other character (spaces, punctuation, digits, etc.), leave it completely unchanged.
description_json.decrypt_rules:
For each character in the text:
1. If it is an uppercase letter (A-Z), shift it backward by 3 positions in the alphabet, wrapping around if necessary (e.g., D becomes A, B becomes Y, C becomes Z).
2. If it is a lowercase letter (a-z), shift it forward by 3 positions in the alphabet, wrapping around if necessary (e.g., x becomes a, y becomes b, z becomes c, a becomes d).
3. If it is any other character (spaces, punctuation, digits, etc.), leave it completely unchanged.
